test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If P is 15 percent less than Q, then Q is how much percentage more than P?
solution:
**Given:**

P is 15% less than Q.

Let Q = 100, then P = 85.

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = ((Q - P) / P) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((100 - 85) / 85) × 100

⇒ (15 / 85) × 100

⇒ 17.64%

**∴ Q is 17.64% more than P.**
